DESCRIPTION:
Rocky Mountain Cycling Club RMCC
With this ride we'll start the transition into doing some of our more off-season routes. The goal of these rides is still to be fun, scenic, and challenging, but just not quite as much climbing as we have been doing!

For this one we'll meet at south side of the Littleton/Mineral Park-n-Ride at 9:45 for a 10:00 departure. We'll wind our way through Chatfield and Sterling Ranch and then ride some more rural roads down to Castle Rock. We'll work our way through town and then take in Sapphire Point, Mesa, Daniels Park, and then take some quiet streets and bike path through Highlands Ranch back to Littleton.

The total route is 57 miles and we still add up about 4000 feet of vertical--so definitely not flat!

https://ridewithgps.com/routes/48926211

These are mostly quiet roads; there are a few sections with more moderate levels of traffic, as well as some bike path. But, because I do try to avoid traffic as much as possible, this route does have a lot of turns so I highly recommend downloading this beforehand!

We will regroup periodically, but this should still be considered a drop ride. Our regroup-at-the-store point is at the McDonald's in Castle Rock.

It's that time of the year where rides are subject to being rescheduled or cancelled due to weather. If you think you want to do this ride, then please RSVP so you are notified of any changes.

Non-dues paying members are invited to join us on the rides--once you've done 3 rides with the club we do ask that you join: https://rockymountaincyclingclub.com/

SUMMARY: Project Hero end of season celebration
DESCRIPTION:
Rocky Mountain Cycling Club RMCC
Join Project Hero to celebrate Veterans Day!

3 rides - all chill
Easy Peasy - 6 miles golden ponds
Moderate - 16 miles sandstone ranch
Leg Breaker - 24 miles LOBO to Boulder reservoir

Followed by lunch celebrating over 30,000 miles logged by our Denver vets

Rocky Mountain Cycling Club RMCC
Please join us for what is usually one of our most popular rides of the year, the RMCC New Year's Day Century!

The route takes in the great flatter in Boulder and Larimer counties, with a few short climbs throw in, including Carter Lake and Masonville. The ride features wide-open roads, big shoulders that should be clear of snow/ice, and relatively manageable traffic.

https://ridewithgps.com/routes/53217725

Location: Starts/ends at the US 36/McCaslin Park & Ride on the NW corner of the US-36/McCaslin Blvd interchange. We meet on the south end of the lot close to the light rail tracks.

We will meet at 8 AM with departure at 8:15 AM.

Support/regroup points:

1. Lyons: Circle K, 24 miles
2. Loveland: Sandy's, 63 miles
3. Hygiene: Mountain Mercantile, 84 miles

While we do regroup on a periodic basis, this should be considered a drop ride.

Looking for something a little shorter? That's easy to do. Cutting off the whole part north of Hygiene will give you 58 miles. Skipping the Masonville loop will give you 80.

Non-dues paying members are invited to join us on this ride, once you've done 3 rides with the club we do ask that you join: https://rockymountaincyclingclub.com/. It's only $25 for the year!

The event date could change depending on the weather and road conditions.
